entities.summary: First book of the Bible, narrating the creation of the world, the Fall, the Flood, and the stories of the patriarchs (Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, Joseph). Establishes the theological foundations of the entire biblical narrative: creation, covenant, sin, and promise.
